responsibility: Defines the client-facing hook interfaces by which the diagnostics subsystem queries compiler-specific metadata that it does not own itself. These abstract classes provide access to version and plugin information, logical location managers and current logical locations, per-file SARIF sourceLanguage values, and custom SARIF invocation properties, allowing sinks such as SARIF and HTML to enrich emitted diagnostics with frontend or driver metadata without depending directly on GCC language internals.
